title: Oppenheimer recalls the Trinity test and the Bhagavad Gita

tellings.quote: I remembered the line from the Hindu scripture, the Bhagavad Gita. Now I am become death, the destroyer of worlds.

plain: The physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer, who led the making of the first atomic bomb, recalls that at the Trinity test, the first atomic bomb blast, in the New Mexico desert in 1945, he thought of a line from the Hindu scripture the Bhagavad Gita: "Now I am become death, the destroyer of worlds." He tells it in his own words, in a recording played on an episode about Air Force veterans, as a picture of what the bomb meant.
